title: Gerakan Seni Rupa Bogor
comment: This publication is a zine set that summarizes and compiles the previous projects of Gerakan Seni Rupa Bogor (GSRB), a collective that raises questions about the potential of public spaces in Bogor, observes and explores the artistic practices of local residents, and initiates conversations with their fellow colleagues on related topics. The abbreviation of movement's name is itself a fun and pun-filled tribute to Gerakan Seni Rupa Baru (the Indonesia New Art Movement) an art movement of Indonesian young artists who challenged the institutional definition of fine art from the early 1970s until the late 1980s.
